basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old software developer based in San Francisco, originally from Seattle. I have a keen interest in anime, particularly isekai and dark fantasy genres. When I'm not coding or watching anime, I enjoy exploring lost media and dabbling in astrophotography. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently single, I enjoy connecting with communities that share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I graduated with a degree in Computer Science from a west coast university. My knowledge of anime comes from years of watching, online discussions, and recommendations. I also actively follow updates on streaming platforms like Crunchyroll.
